title: Photos
description: Photo library (capability photos). All photo operations ride POST /photos with envelope gating protocol_v->min_peer_build->capability->token->payload. Chunks reuse 1 MiB raw max (~1.4 MiB b64) to stay under MaxBodyBytes 8 MiB. Photo IDs are opaque MediaStore row IDs (string, 1..128, digits only). Listing is cursor-paged (date_taken DESC, _id DESC) with limit 1..200 (default 100). Thumbs are fetched separately via photo-thumb-req/resp (viewport-first, LRU cache, per-thumb retry) so one bad thumb never fails the page. Full-res is streamed via photo-chunk (transfer_id+offset idempotent, sha256 on last chunk). Permission errors carry error_code=permission_denied + permission=photos so Mac can render separate empty-states for files vs photos; decoders ignore unknown fields.

nonce.description: Random per-message value the ack must echo.

req_id.description: Correlation id for req/resp pairs (photo-list, thumb-req, delete).

cursor.description: Opaque paging cursor (empty = first page). Sort is date_taken DESC, _id DESC.

next_cursor.description: Cursor for next page (empty = no more pages).

photo_id.description: Opaque MediaStore row ID (digits, 1..128). Never a filesystem path.

taken_at.description: Unix millis when photo was taken (MediaStore DATE_TAKEN or DATE_MODIFIED fallback).

thumb_size.description: Requested thumb long edge in px (64..1024). Server clamps and returns actual size in entry.

mime.description: MIME of thumb or full-res (image/jpeg, image/png, image/heic...).

data_b64.description: Base64 thumb bytes (max ~1.4 MiB) or photo-chunk bytes (1 MiB raw cap). Empty only for zero-byte edge.

error.description: Human error for resp (e.g. permission prompt).

error_code.description: Machine error_code: permission_denied, not_found, invalid_arg, internal. Separate from human error.

permission.description: Which permission domain failed: photos or files. Lets Mac render separate empty-states.

transfer_id.description: Hex id for chunked photo transfer (16-64 hex chars, crypto/rand).

sha256.description: Optional hex sha256 of full file (last chunk only).

results.description: Per-item delete results for photo-delete-resp (partial success is normal).
